commitments.detail: Repair at the earliest convenience, priority level 2.
Immediate pickup for battery packs, next business day transfer for rugged tablets, high priority repair for power converters, and calibration request for electronic test cables.
Immediate action required for battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables.
Power converters need to be prioritized for repair.
Electronic test cables require calibration at the earliest convenience.
Battery packs to be picked up immediately by the property office.
Rugged tablets to be transferred to the repair bench for next business day.
Power converters to be repaired with priority level 2.
Electronic test cables to be sent to the calibration desk for calibration within one week of Q1 end.
